flags.message: On this 28 U.S.C. 1253 direct appeal docket, Appellees filed a 'Motion to dismiss' on September 18, 2026 (rather than a 'Motion to dismiss or affirm') and Appellants filed a 'Response to motion to dismiss' on September 29, 2026. Both entries carry supremecourt.gov DocketPDF URLs in snapshots/2026-11-09.json, but neither filing was provisioned into record/documents/documents.json.
